description: Vehicle 1 goes straight through an intersection. Vehicle 2 approaches from the perpendicular road to the left of Vehicle 1’s approach and turns left onto Vehicle 1’s exit road. Vehicle 3 approaches from the perpendicular road to the right of Vehicle 1’s approach and turns right onto Vehicle 1’s exit road. Vehicle 4 is traveling in the same direction as Vehicle 1 and starts behind Vehicle 1 in an adjacent lane; Vehicle 4 changes lanes into Vehicle 1’s lane after the intersection. On Vehicle 1’s exit road, cones partially block the lane width so that only a narrow strip near the left edge remains passable.
